title: Case: Recipient confirms item recovered after storm disruption
context: A parcel was misdelivered during severe flooding. The carrier's recovery team located and confirmed recovery with the recipient. The desk observes follow-up communication confirming the fix is complete.
initial_request: None; this is a status update following prior coordination.

events.from: Marko Chen, Plover Arc Logistics Dispatch
events.body: DL-937 parcels delayed. Storm surge flooded access road to Saltspur. Rerouting delivery attempt for tomorrow.

events.from: Jen Morag, Plover Arc Logistics Delivery investigations
events.body: DL-937: driver reported parcel left at 42 Breaker Lane instead of 42 Seawall Terrace due to road closure. Recipient at correct address not yet located. Flagged to Recovery team.

events.from: Dale Pritchard, recipient at 42 Seawall Terrace
events.body: I found my package at my neighbour's place (42 Breaker Lane). They kept it safe during the flooding. I have it now. Thanks.

events.to: Jen Morag, Plover Arc Logistics Delivery investigations
events.body: DL-937 confirmed recovered by recipient. Closed as misdelivery resolved.

events.from: Jen Morag, Plover Arc Logistics Delivery investigations
events.body: Confirming DL-937 recovery complete as per recipient contact. No further action needed from our side.

must: Recognize that the recovery investigation is closed and confirmed by both recipient and investigations team
Log the case outcome without sending additional contact messages
Do not duplicate or restate the already-confirmed resolution
must_not: Send another message to the recipient asking for confirmation (already given)
Contact Recovery team with a new action request (investigation confirmed complete)
Escalate to supervisor (this is routine closure, not a problem)
Re-request status from Delivery investigations (status already provided in event 5)

rationale: The recipient has confirmed receipt of the parcel, Delivery investigations has explicitly closed the case and confirmed no further action is required from the carrier, and the desk has already notified investigations of the resolution. A third message would be noise. The right move is to log the closure and take no action.
